subject.title: fix(matrix): journal inbound events before advancing sync token

question: Is the remaining E2EE pre-decryption crash window acceptable for this Matrix durability landing, provided the PR clearly limits its guarantee to events emitted by the decrypt bridge?
rationale: The branch intentionally improves the journal boundary only after decrypted events are emitted; deciding whether that remaining message-loss window is acceptable is a scope decision rather than a mechanical review finding.

options.title: Land the bounded adapter after live proof
options.body: Accept the documented E2EE limitation for this landing once a real Matrix crash/restart replay run demonstrates the non-encrypted path.

options.title: Expand recovery before landing
options.body: Require raw encrypted-event persistence and replay through the crypto pipeline so the sync-token boundary also covers pre-decryption events.

options.title: Split and track E2EE recovery
options.body: Land only after creating and linking a narrowly scoped follow-up that owns raw encrypted-event recovery.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded adapter after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the documented E2EE limitation for this landing once a real Matrix crash/restart replay run demonstrates the non-encrypted path.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared ingress contract and its intended adapter boundary originate in the merged core durable-ingress work.
